snippet.title: Cherry Tree High I! My! Girls Trailer
snippet.description:
Cherry Tree High I! My! Girls! is a linear visual novel that picks up the story from the popular adventure game Cherry Tree High Comedy Club and adds new stages, new music, and three new characters to the roster! 


Overview:
Now that Mairu and friends have successfully re-opened the club, they actually need to act like a club! Mairu’s nemesis Chitose hasn’t run out of tricks to catch them out just yet, so they’ll need to be careful! But the Chitose isn’t the only problem that Mairu and friends have to contend with... A rival club is competing for the spot of number one entertainment, and a new transfer student will deeply affect the Comedy Club line-up!

Visit the Cherry Tree High homepage: http://cherrytreehigh.com

Cherry Tree High I! My! Girls! on Steam Greenlight:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=315826875

Cherry Tree High Comedy Club on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/214610/

Created by circle 773 and localized and published by Nyu Media Ltd.
